Notability is hiring an early-career backend software engineer to build and maintain the central systems used by its clients. The role focuses on backend features, reliable code, scalability, and collaboration in support of the company’s learning product and business growth.
Enterprise Software
Software
Productivity Tools
Growth Opportunities
Responsibilities
Own core features across our entire backend system, from direct interactions with client software to database queries to the nitty-gritty of scalability challenges
Ship stable, readable, well-tested code serving Notability’s whole business
Communicate clearly, concisely and proactively in writing, conversation and use of AI: crisp problem statements and messages, readable PR descriptions, well-timed questions, honest status
Drive your work to completion: you find a way around ambiguity, review feedback, and edge cases
Jump into unfamiliar areas to solve tough problems
Operate with respect for the ideas, victories, mistakes, and time of your collaborators
Take in feedback from mentors and peers to continuously self-improve
Bring ideas and opinions: balance product and tech needs through open collaboration
Qualification
Web Development
TypeScript
GraphQL
Infrastructure as Code
Docker
Google Cloud Platform
Amazon Web Services
LLM APIs
AI Agents
Required
Evidence you've shipped something real, professionally or on your own
Clear, concise communication, written and verbal: you make complex things simple for the people around you, and teammates are energized by working with you
Good judgment, and ownership of outcomes rather than tasks
Genuine care for the people you work with: you build trust, give and receive feedback well, and treat collaboration as the job rather than an interruption to it
Solid grasp of web fundamentals (browser, network, async behavior, application state)
Fluency with AI coding tools
Demonstrated curiosity: something you built, wrote, or figured out on your own initiative
Preferred
Comfort reading and reasoning about TypeScript, and modern web code
Experience with GraphQL
Experience with infrastructure as code and/or Docker
Experience with Google Cloud Provider or Amazon Web Services
Experience building with LLM APIs, agents, or AI-assisted developer workflows
Writing, teaching or learning in public via a blog, repo, etc
Benefits
Competitive compensation that includes bonuses and profit sharing
Equity Awards in the form of Stock Options
Comprehensive healthcare fully covered for you and your family including medical, dental, and vision
Flexible work and vacation schedules
401k with matching contributions
Matching gifts to nonprofits
Lunch Stipend (When Working from HQ)
Public transit stipend
Home workstation reimbursement
ISP stipend
Monthly phone bill stipend
Hybrid model, with a minimum of two days onsite at our downtown San Francisco office and flexibility to work remotely from home the rest of the week
Flexible schedules
An “as long as you get your work done” approach to time off
Height-adjustable desks
A well-stocked kitchen full of goodies
